show.name: Lois & Clark: The New Adventures of Superman
show.summary: A sleek, sexy, Emmy-nominated 1990s take on the enduring superhero, culled from DC Comics, which has spawned numerous successful film and TV versions of him as boy and man. All of which further demonstrated that while Kryptonite can kill the Man of Steel, changing times can't. Here, leads Dean Cain and Teri Hatcher have the looks and the chemistry, and the timeless question (seriously, how can Lois NOT know Clark is Superman?) plays itself out until they find true love.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.summary: Clark's parents devise a superhero persona so he can investigate Luthor's connection to the sabotage of a space shuttle.

episodes.name: Strange Visitor (from Another Planet)
episodes.summary: A renegade government agent targets Clark and Lois in an attempt to capture Superman.

episodes.name: Neverending Battle
episodes.summary: Luthor engages Superman in tests that make him confront the limitations of his powers.

episodes.name: I'm Looking Through You
episodes.summary: An invisible man terrorizes Metropolis, staging violent robberies and helping vicious criminals escape.

episodes.name: Requiem for a Superhero
episodes.summary: Lois and Clark investigate some strangely powerful boxers - and Lois is surprised to discover the man behind their secret is her estranged father.

episodes.name: I've Got a Crush on You
episodes.summary: Lois' undercover persona, a nightclub singer, arouses unexpected interest. Plus, can Superman halt the activities of a group of arsonists?

episodes.name: Smart Kids
episodes.summary: Juvenile delinquents playing high-tech pranks are hooked on a dangerous drug that boosts intelligence.

episodes.name: The Green, Green Glow of Home
episodes.summary: A friend of Jonathan and Martha has found a strange meteorite, Jason Trask is back and now he is in Smallville, looking for this meteorite that can destroy Superman, and Lois and Clark go to Smallville to investigate the story and Clark introduces her to his parents.

episodes.name: The Man of Steel Bars
episodes.summary: Superman winds up in jail after authorities decide he is responsible for a freak winter heat wave.

episodes.name: Pheromone, My Lovely
episodes.summary: A powerful perfume leads Lois to unleash her hidden feelings for Clark, who isn't too pleased with the situation.

episodes.name: Honeymoon in Metropolis
episodes.summary: Lois and Clark cannot ignore their growing attraction to each other while posing as newlyweds during a surveillance operation.

episodes.name: All Shook Up
episodes.summary: Superman's encounter with an asteroid headed for Earth results in amnesia for Clark, who forgets how to use his powers.

episodes.name: Witness
episodes.summary: Lois' life is in danger when she witnesses the murder of a scientist who was claiming to know the secret to increased male potency. Now, Clark and Perry need to protect her from the murderer, Mr Make-up, and from the scientist's affair from the past.

episodes.name: Illusions of Grandeur
episodes.summary: Lois and Clark work to uncover the truth behind some strange disappearances that lead to mystery, magic, and a possible murder.

episodes.name: The Ides of Metropolis
episodes.summary: Clark is skeptical as a sympathetic Lois harbors a fugitive and they search for an antidote to a world-threatening computer virus.

episodes.name: Foundling
episodes.summary: As Clark begins to discover more about his mysterious past, Lex Luthor also learns more about Superman's true identity.

episodes.name: The Rival
episodes.summary: Lois is overcome by jealousy when her college rival publishes several top news stories and also expresses a romantic interest in Clark.

episodes.name: Vatman
episodes.summary: Clark senses a kindred spirit when he is confronted by a new enemy: a Superman clone determined to destroy the man of steel.

episodes.name: Fly Hard
episodes.summary: Clark's true identity is in jeopardy when he is forced to save friends who are taken hostage when terrorists invade the Daily Planet.

episodes.name: Barbarians at the Planet
episodes.summary: Clark may lose his position and his partner when Lex Luthor takes over both the Daily Planet newspaper and Lois' affections.

episodes.name: The House of Luthor
episodes.summary: Lois agrees to marry Luthor, unaware he has imprisoned Superman in a cell made of kryptonite.
